Which advantage of the internet for young people do you think is most important? Explain
why.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain why the use of the internet by young people is an important issue for governments.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘We are spending too much money on computers.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘The costs of technology are increasing every year.’
How would you test this claim? You should consider the types of information, sources of
evidence or methods you might use.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify one prediction from Kim’s statement.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify one fact from Sumin’s statement.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Identify an example of vested interest in Sumin’s statement. Explain why this is vested
interest.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Kim’s or Sumin’s?
Your answer should consider both statements and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different types of information used.

text: Young people need to be protected from the internet because it is harmful.
Do you agree with this statement?
• give reasons and evidence to support your opinion
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
